summary: Billboard quad vertex writer for a particle sprite. Builds a camera-facing unit perpendicular from the cross product of the particle axis vector a2[18..20] and the facing vector a3[0..2], scales it by half the particle size (this[4] * 0.5), then computes the four quad corners around the particle center a2[11..13]. Each corner is written to the particle texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer. When the cross-product magnitude is zero the perpendicular degenerates to an axis-aligned half-extent.

operations.description: Compute the three cross-product components of a2[18..20] x a3[0..2]: v6, v9, v12.
Compute the squared magnitude of the perpendicular as v3 = v12^2 + v9^2 + v6^2.
Guard on the squared magnitude v3 > 0.0 (zero-threshold test); when zero the perpendicular direction is degenerate and an axis-aligned fallback is used instead.
When non-degenerate: scale the unit perpendicular by half the particle size, v4 = this[4] * 0.5 / sqrt(v3), and form the scaled perpendicular components v15, v16, v17.
Degenerate fallback: v15 = 0.0, v17 = 0.0, v16 = this[4] * 0.5 (axis-aligned half-extent).
First quad corner: particle center a2[11..13] plus the scaled perpendicular (v18, v20, v22).

Write quad corner 1 and corner 2 (corner 2 = corner 1 minus the facing vector a3[0..2]) to the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer, passing the texture handle *(_DWORD*)a2, the corner index, the corner position, and the color *((_DWORD*)a2 + 24).
Remaining two corners: particle center a2[11..13] minus the scaled perpendicular (v19, v21, v23), then minus the facing vector a3[0..2] for the last corner (v8, v11, v14).
Write quad corners 0 and 3 to the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer with the same texture handle and color.
Return the result of the final PixelWriteToTextureBuffer call.
Invoked from ParticleSpawnFunction (0x004CCE90) and ParticleSystemUpdateWithWindAndDamping (0x004CD220) to emit particle quad vertices.

clean_pseudocode: // a2[0] texture handle, a2[11..13] particle center, a2[18..20] axis vector,
// a2[24] vertex color, this[4] particle size (half-extent basis).
hx = v6*s; hy = v9*s; hz = v12*s;
return PixelWriteToTextureBuffer(a2[0], 3, a2[11]-hx-a3[0], a2[12]-hy-a3[1], a2[13]-hz-a3[2], a2[24]);
